subject: Trading
title: Pre-Trade Checklists
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Pre-Trade Checklists.

hook.text: Surgeons use checklists. Pilots use checklists. They reduce errors by 30–50%. Traders desperately need them too.

buildup.text: A pre-trade checklist might include: trend direction, key levels, risk-reward ratio, position size, and catalyst.

discovery.text: If any box isn't checked, the trade doesn't happen. No exceptions. That's how discipline is automated.

twist.text: The checklist's power isn't what it includes—it's what it prevents: impulsive, criteria-free trades.

climax.text: Over time, the checklist becomes second nature. What started as discipline becomes intuition backed by process.

punchline.text: Checklists turn discipline into a habit.

quiz.question: What is the main benefit of a pre-trade checklist?
options: Preventing impulsive trades that don't meet criteria
